coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): the FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit comparison and all five dependent variables. Prefill, decode, and combined execution times are represented directly or through the timing quantities used in throughput calculations; peak memory and phase speedups are also included.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies model sizes instead of holding LLaMa-2-7B fixed and substitutes a custom benchmarking protocol for e2e/benchmark.py. Batch size 1 and prefill length 2048 appear only within broader sweeps rather than as the specified settings, and decode_steps=32 is missing. Additional hardware, precision baselines, and quality experiments substantially broaden the intended experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the comparison of QuaRot 4-bit versus FP16 prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, and phase-specific speedup factors.
